quality.review_scope: Independent root R2 scientific and apparatus audit of all five supplied main pages, Scheme 1, Figures 1–8 and the 34-reference bibliography passed. SI and cited references remain unreviewed. Presentation refinements pending; no measured-coordinate admission.
missing_fields: Complete supplied five-page main; matching local SI not located or verified, cited full texts unreviewed.

Source conditions are kept within their separately identified typical, ligand-series, solvent-series and polymer-loading scopes; matching a nominal ratio does not establish the same physical specimen.
Salt/water removal procedure, wash volumes and repetitions, final nanocrystal concentration, isolation yield and storage are unspecified.
Polymerization gives BG:PPG:TDI = 1:1:1.6 and 50 wt% DMF but no absolute monomer, nanocrystal or catalyst charges, unambiguous50 wt% denominator, gas flow or film casting/curing recipe.
Atomic coordinates, refined lattice constants and sample-specific unit cells are unavailable; illustrative molecular and apparatus views do not supply measured structures.
Source conflicts in duration, ligand-size trends, TGA labels and IR wavenumber are retained without correction.
Independent source audit passed; presentation remains pending.
conflicts: The detailed CdS procedure specifies an additional 4 h at room temperature, Scheme 1 and Figures1–5 specify2 h, and the discussion claims preparation in 20 min. These are separately retained, not harmonized.

The text reports Brus-model diameters3.88 nm at ME/Cd2+=0.5,4.34 nm at 1, and 5.02 nm at 2, while its narrative says increasing ligand produces a blue shift and smaller size. Explicit size assignments are retained; the396/400/410 nm list is not silently reassigned to repair the trend.
Figure 5 caption assigns(a) without ME and(b) with ME; adjacent text reverses the labels. Caption assignment is used for the displayed panel with the text conflict disclosed.
Figure 6a labels 2960 cm−1, whereas the prose gives 2926 cm−1; both are retained with their locators.
